unit.why: A brief anecdote: on Rosh Hashanah night the Seer of Lublin eats a certain dish, asks his disciples why, and approves R. Simha Bunem's answer.

stories.start_quote: פ״א בליל ר"ה אכל הרבי מלובלין
stories.summary_en: On Rosh Hashanah night the Seer of Lublin ate a dish (grieflech) and asked his disciples to explain why; R. Simha Bunem answered that the rebbe was 'sweetening harsh judgments', and the rebbe praised his answer.

quotes: פ״א בליל ר"ה אכל הרבי מלובלין
tags.why: Set on the night of Rosh Hashanah

quotes: ושאל לתלמידיו שיכוונו הטעם למה אוכל זה
tags.why: The master tests his disciples and approves a disciple's answer
The answer gives a mystical reason, the sweetening of judgments
